description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Encoder', a utility class responsible for encoding and decoding UTF-8 strings, handling iconv encoding conversions, cleaning strings for valid UTF-8, converting from Unicode codepoints, and providing wrappers around iconv behavior with workarounds for known bugs. It also offers static methods to support character encoding support checks and conversion reliability.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Encoder
classes.description: A static utility class for UTF-8 encoding operations, normalization, and iconv compatibility checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation; class functions are static.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: Empty error handler function that suppresses error messages during iconv operations.

methods.name: unsafeIconv
methods.description: Wrapper around iconv that sets a custom error handler to suppress errors, performs the conversion, then restores the original error handler.

methods.name: iconv
methods.description: Performs iconv conversion with handling for known font truncation bugs and chunking for UTF-8 strings.

methods.name: cleanUTF8
methods.description: Cleans a UTF-8 string to remove invalid or non-SGML characters, ensuring well-formedness based on specified character ranges.

methods.name: unichr
methods.description: Converts a Unicode codepoint into its UTF-8 string representation.

methods.name: iconvAvailable
methods.description: Checks if iconv is available and not buggy for truncation issues.

methods.name: convertToUTF8
methods.description: Converts input string from specified encoding to UTF-8, using iconv or fallback options; throws exceptions if not supported.

methods.name: convertFromUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to another encoding based on configuration, possibly using iconv or mb_convert_encoding.

methods.name: convertToASCIIDumbLossless
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string into ASCII entities, replacing non-ASCII characters with numeric character references.

methods.name: testIconvTruncateBug
methods.description: Tests whether iconv is buggy when truncating output at buffer boundaries from UTF-8 to other encodings.

methods.name: testEncodingSupportsASCII
methods.description: Checks if a given encoding supports ASCII characters and provides mappings for known problematic encodings.
